title: A rectangular baseline, displaced between the two possible thresholds
why: Every other one-match case uses a **square** baseline, where `min` and `max` are the same number — so an engine normalising by the larger dimension passes all of them while granting five times the movement here. `0.25 × min(40, 8) = 2` and `0.25 × max(40, 8) = 10`; the displacement is 4, which fires under the contract's denominator and passes under the other.
